desc:
⚡ Welcome to the next chapter of Age of Heroes, the sequel: Fall Of Heroes.

🦸 Choose your powers and create your own unique superhero
⚔️ Master combat, level up, and battle other players
🌆 Explore the city by flying, zipping, teleporting, and more
🚨 Join chaotic server-wide events, missions, and battles
🎨 Build and customise your own superhero suit
💥 Collect iconic Marvel and DC-inspired gear to enhance your abilities

🔥 Forge your hero, protect the city, and become a legend! OR:
🦹‍♂️ Cause chaos and rule the server as the most feared Villain.
